full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No.7 of 2003 in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Khulna Sadar impleading the opposite party No. 15, Bangladesh represented by the Collector and Deputy Commissioner, Khulna for declaration that the judgment and decree passed in F.M.A. No.246 of 1969 is forged, fraudulent and not binding on the plaintiff. The said F.A. 246 of 1969 arose out of Title Suit No.1779 of 1969 which was a suit for specific performance of contract which was dismissed by the trial court but decreed in the first appeal by the High Court Division in F.A. No.246 of 1969.
